snippet.title: Morbid: The Lords of Ire | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam, Epic, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch.

Buy now on:
Steam: https://bit.ly/MTLOI-Steam
Epic: https://bit.ly/MTLOI-Epic
PlayStation: https://bit.ly/MTLOI-PS5
Xbox: https://bit.ly/MTLOI-XBOX
Switch: https://bit.ly/MTLOI-Switch

Risk insanity in the gruesome slash-em-up Morbid: The Lords of Ire, with brutal combat and souls-like elements. Defeat the five Lords of Ire as you fight for your life across tortured landscapes, rending the evil Gahars of their flesh-bound forms.

Follow Morbid: The Lords of Ire on socials to keep up to date with the latest news: https://linktr.ee/morbidthegame

Still Running Discord: https://discord.gg/Be2sT6a49v
Still Running Twitter: https://twitter.com/StillRunningDEV
Still Running Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stillrunninggame

Morbid Twitter: https://twitter.com/MorbidTheGame
Morbid Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/morbidthegame
